name: Genetics: Babies Take After Their Parents
description: Gives A New Home the head genetics of the later games. In the original game a baby's head is picked at random and neither parent's looks count; with this patch a baby's head comes from its parents, by The Lost Children, The Secret City, The Tree of Life and New Believers' own rule: the father's head and the mother's head added and halved (rounded down), then one row lower, the same or one row higher, one chance in three each; on 5 births in 100 any head instead, as the game rolls it. A boy's head stays within the boys' heads (0 to 18), so no boy is ever given head 19, which stays the Golden Child's; a girl's within 0 to 19. When the father is not known -- "Unknown", or a birth whose conception was not recorded -- the mother's head alone is used, with the same one-row step and the same 5 in 100. Twins and triplets share the first baby's head, as in every game. Bodies stay random, as in every game, and the Golden Child, new villages and island events' villagers are the game's own. **Needs Show Parents in Details Screen to know each baby's father; without it every baby takes after its mother.** **Works the same with every other patch and in every population mode.** **Not yet tested in a running game.** The companion is "VVFP VV1 Genetics.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; if the DLL cannot be loaded, the game is stock.
behavior_changes: The villager creator 0x43C350, when the pregnancy tick calls it for the first child of a birth (0x42EFD0, returning to 0x42EFD5), stores at 0x43C647 a head from the parents instead of the head it rolled: rand(100) < 5 keeps the rolled head (rand(19) for a boy, rand(20) for a girl, as stock); otherwise base + rand(3) - 1, made 0 below 0 and 18 (a boy) or 19 (a girl) above, from the game's own rand 0x402F10.

base is (father's head + mother's head) / 2, rounded down, with the father VVFP VV1 Parentage.dll stashed against the mother at the conception (Vv1ParentageQueryExpectedFather); the mother's head alone when that DLL is not there, knows no father, or gives a head outside 0..19.
Twins and triplets (0x43C840 at 0x42F021 and 0x42F06D) copy the first child's head, so they share the inherited head.
explicit_non_changes: This row changes no executable bytes: the DLL verifies the creator's head and body rolls (0x43C616..0x43C64C, but for the rand calls' targets and the name roll's bound) and the game's rand, and writes its one detour at run time through the shared all-or-none writer; a different build installs nothing.
Bodies, sexes, names, likes and dislikes are rolled as in the stock game.

The Golden Child (family 199: head and body 19 from the creator's own branch), the first villagers of a new village, and every villager an island event or Story / Cheat Upgrades makes are the game's own; only births from a pregnancy change.
No save byte or file is written: the head is the record's own field, saved by the game.

runtime_detours.routine: the villager creator 0x43C350's head store (mov [esi+0x360], eax): the head from the parents for a birth's first child, then on at 0x43C64D
runtime_detours.installed_by: VVFP VV1 Genetics.dll, VvfpStartup (started by VVFP Startup.dll, second word)
